# Abū l-Ḥasan al-Ashʿarī

*874 – 936 · Arab · [Kalām](../movements/kalam.md)*

A theologian who moved from Muʿtazilism to the defence of divine omnipotence, founder of the Ashʿarite school of [kalām](../movements/kalam.md).
